gold_references.title: Koapt-therapy-based treatment and rehabilitation device for degenerative knee joint disease
independent_claims: 1. A KOAPT-therapy-based treatment and rehabilitation device for degenerative knee joint disease, the device comprises a Correct and Comfortable Relationship (CCR) data collection component, a motion quantity data collection component, a support component, a control component, and a feedback component; the support component is used to provide trunk support and/or waist support and/or elbow support for the user; 2022383121 the CCR data collection component is installed on the support component to collect body data of the user during therapy; the CCR comprising a relationship between correct and comfortable body postures subject to KOAPT requirements and body movement forms in motion status; the body data comprises elbow support point height, supporting leg load reduction, trunk upright status value, and leg upright state value; the motion quantity data collection component is installed on the support component to collect a motion quantity data of the user's leg swinging movements during use in real time; the motion quantity data comprises the number of leg swinging movements, movement frequency, and movement amplitude; the control component is used to execute the KOAPT computer program installed in the control module, real-time collect the body data of the user in use, and real-time determine whether the elbow support point height, supporting leg load reduction, trunk upright status value, and upright leg status value during the user's exercise match the preset CCR value; when the user’s CCR doesn’t match the KOAPT requirements, the feedback component receives feedback instructions from the control component and communicates corresponding information to the user, to correct the user’s movement posture; the computer program also receives the motion quantity data sent by the motion quantity data collection component in real-time, and guide the user to complete the treatment and rehabilitation exercise according to the graduated treatment models; the feedback component is used to send audio and/or video and/or tactile signals to the user according to the feedback instructions from the control component; wherein the graduated treatment models consist of X1, X2 and X3 level treatment models, each graduated treatment model has preset multiple parameters, including: graduated period, single-leg support count T, movement amplitude θ, movement frequency ω, leg assistance force F, movement quantity C, necessary supporting leg rest time t, and supporting leg load reduction Δa, and wherein the support component comprises a folding leg swing mechanism and a multifunctional support frame, the folding leg swing mechanism is used to support the user's torso, while the multifunctional support frame is used to support the user's elbows, and both are fixed and connected, and wherein collecting the movement amplitude involves placing a distance sensor on a surface of the bottom support of the support component, and wherein the movement amplitude θ is

2. The device of claim 1, wherein the KOAPT computer program comprises a graduated treatment models storage module, a CCR analysis module, a treatment process control module, a treatment tracking module, a feedback information storage module, and a user information storage module; the graduated treatment models storage module is used to store the graduated treatment models; the CCR analysis module inputs the real-time collected body data into the CCR 2022383121 analysis model, real-time determines the user's posture information, and output CCR judgment instructions; when the user's CCR is incorrect, it simultaneously outputs an incorrectness flag; the treatment process control module is used to call the corresponding feedback instructions in the feedback information storage module based on the CCR judgment instructions; the treatment process control module matches the number of leg swinging movements, movement frequency, and movement amplitude collected by the motion quantity data collection component with the corresponding values in the graduated treatment models, and calls the corresponding feedback instructions in the feedback information storage module based on the matching results; the treatment tracking module monitors the progress and completion of the user's treatment process and to call the corresponding feedback instructions in the feedback information storage module; the feedback information storage module comprises count standard feedback information, CCR standard feedback information, incentive feedback information, separation alarm information, and media information; the user information storage module stores the user's personal information, body data, and motion quantity data.

3. The device of claim 1, wherein the CCR analysis model is represented by the equation y = k1 + k2 + k3 + k4 + k5, wherein y is the user's CCR indicative value, k1 is trunk upright indicative value, k2 is leg upright indicative value, k3 is supporting leg load reduction indicative value, k4 is comfort indicative value, and k5 is redundancy indicative value; When y = 0, the user's CCR is correct, and when y = 1, the user's CCR is incorrect.
gold_references.arrangement_analysis: The prior-art patent discloses a device with various components, but it does not mention a blood pressure monitor or a reference pressure sensor. The adjustable cavity design is also not mentioned. The arrangement of a blood pressure monitor with a blood pressure cuff, a reference pressure sensor, and an adjustable cavity design is not disclosed in the prior-art patent.
gold_references.relevance_assessment: The prior-art patent is about a treatment and rehabilitation device for degenerative knee joint disease, which is unrelated to blood pressure monitoring technology.

independent_claims: 1. An tus for ted control of gas washout of a non-invasive patient interface of a respiratory treatment apparatus comprising: a vent assembly having a le t area defined by one or more apertures of the vent assembly, the vent assembly being associated with the non-invasive t interface to vent expiratory gas, positioned in an air delivery path between a flow generator and the non-invasive patient interface, and proximal to the non-invasive patient interface; an actuator to manipulate said one or more apertures of the vent assembly; and a controller, including a processor, that is coupled to the actuator and configured to operate the actuator to change the variable exhaust area of the vent ly, wherein the variable exhaust area is configured to be set to a plurality of open positions, the plurality of open positions providing ent vent flow areas that are adapted to provide an increase or decrease in flow rate of the expiratory gas h the variable exhaust area.
2. The apparatus of claim 1 wherein the controller is configured to switch n a treatment setting for the variable exhaust area and a comfort g for the variable exhaust area.

gold_references.arrangement_analysis: The prior-art patent NZ729631A discloses a respiratory treatment apparatus with a vent assembly, actuator, and controller. However, the arrangement of a blood pressure monitor with a blood pressure cuff, reference pressure sensor, and adjustable cavity design is not explicitly disclosed. The prior-art patent does not mention blood pressure monitoring or the specific elements of the invention. The arrangement of these elements in the invention is not present in the prior-art patent, but the specific arrangement of the elements in the prior-art patent is also not directly related to the invention's elements. Therefore, the required arrangement is uncertain.
gold_references.relevance_assessment: The prior-art patent is about a respiratory treatment apparatus, specifically a vent arrangement for a mask, which is unrelated to a blood pressure monitor.

workarounds.description: Replace the adjustable cavity design with a fixed cavity design that is optimized for a specific range of user sizes. This can be achieved by using a standard-sized cuff and a fixed-position reference pressure sensor.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor can still achieve the commercial value of the invention by providing an accurate and reliable blood pressure reading, albeit with a fixed-size cuff. The fixed cavity design can be optimized to work well for a specific range of user sizes, preserving the economic value of the invention.

workarounds.description: Use an external reference pressure sensor that is not integrated into the blood pressure cuff. This can be achieved by using a separate device that provides a reference pressure reading, which is then used to calibrate the blood pressure cuff.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor can still achieve the commercial value of the invention by providing an accurate and reliable blood pressure reading, albeit with an external reference pressure sensor. This can be a more cost-effective solution and still preserve the economic value of the invention.

workarounds.description: Remove the reference pressure sensor from the blood pressure cuff and instead use a calibration process that is performed by the user or a healthcare professional. This can be achieved by providing a calibration guide or by using a separate device to calibrate the blood pressure cuff.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor does not preserve the economic value of the invention, as the removal of the reference pressure sensor reduces the accuracy and reliability of the blood pressure reading. This workaround may not be acceptable to users who require accurate and reliable readings.

workarounds.description: Use software calibration to adjust the blood pressure reading based on user input or other data. This can be achieved by using a mobile app or a computer program that adjusts the blood pressure reading based on user input or other data.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor can still achieve the commercial value of the invention by providing an accurate and reliable blood pressure reading, albeit with software calibration. This can be a more cost-effective solution and still preserve the economic value of the invention.

workarounds.description: Use multiple blood pressure cuffs of different sizes to accommodate different user sizes. This can be achieved by providing a set of cuffs in different sizes, which can be used to accommodate different user sizes.
workarounds.value_preservation_analysis: The competitor can still achieve the commercial value of the invention by providing an accurate and reliable blood pressure reading, albeit with multiple cuffs. This can be a more cost-effective solution and still preserve the economic value of the invention.
